title: Tracker Core
mission: Single source of truth for Matrix Reprogrammed: uncover wrongdoing, track elite power, map money, follow files and expose protection networks through public records.
boundary: This database tracks public-record leads, records, tasks, people, institutions and money routes. A map node, public mention, wealth status or institutional proximity is not proof of wrongdoing. Strong claims require verified record cards.

evidenceGrades.A: primary public record, court finding, conviction, plea, enforcement action, official disclosure, regulator order or authenticated exhibit
evidenceGrades.B: strong documented lead from multiple records, reputable reporting, settlement, testimony or institutional review
evidenceGrades.C: open lead requiring source pull, counter-source and confidence review
evidenceGrades.X: rejected, false, unsupported, misidentified, privacy-blocked or speculation quarantined

moneyRoutes.name: Court money and settlements
moneyRoutes.recordShows: Payments, settlements, allegations, findings, admissions and denials when filed.
moneyRoutes.recordDoesNotShow: Liability if settlement denies it or has no finding.
moneyRoutes.nextPull: Separate allegation, settlement, admission, finding and denial.

moneyRoutes.name: Property/entity lane
moneyRoutes.recordShows: Entity structures and public asset-control leads where available.
moneyRoutes.recordDoesNotShow: Private residence, family data or wrongdoing.
moneyRoutes.nextPull: Use entity-level summaries; do not publish private addresses.

moneyRoutes.name: Historical transport evidence lane
moneyRoutes.recordShows: Historical flight-log exhibits, registry context or transport references when filed.
moneyRoutes.recordDoesNotShow: Live location, passenger identity or travel purpose without records.
moneyRoutes.nextPull: Use court exhibits and registry context only.

moneyRoutes.name: Reputation and institution access
moneyRoutes.recordShows: Events, donations, media, institutional review, public response and prestige routes.
moneyRoutes.recordDoesNotShow: Intent or wrongdoing without stronger record.
moneyRoutes.nextPull: Pull archive, review, donation and public statement records.
